name: CKEditor 5 Show Blocks
description: Adds a CKEditor 5 toolbar button that outlines every block-level element in the editing area and labels it with its tag name.
project_description:
This module adds the Show Blocks feature to CKEditor 5.

The CKEditor 5 show blocks feature allows content creators to visualize all block-level elements (except for widgets) by surrounding them with an outline and displaying their element name in the top-left corner of the box. It is a thin Drupal integration that exposes CKEditor 5's built-in ShowBlocks plugin as a text-format toolbar toggle; the compiled plugin JavaScript is bundled with the module and served locally.

Support: post bug reports, feature requests and support requests to the CKEditor 5 show blocks module issue queue on drupal.org.

Demo: see the CKEditor 5 show blocks feature guide at ckeditor.com, or launch a sandbox at simplytest.me, enable the module, add the Show Blocks button to a text format's active toolbar at admin/config/content/formats, then edit content and click the button to visualize block-level structure.
